# Pull Request Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] Full test suite passes
- [ ] README reviewed and updated where needed
- [ ] No source PDF modified
- [ ] User-visible behavior manually verified
- [ ] Screenshots updated if UI changed
- [ ] Known limitations documented

## Notes

- Summarize the change in a few sentences
- Mention any manual verification you performed
- Call out README or documentation updates explicitly
